title: Single dot
prompt: Draw one cyan circle in the center of the canvas.
success_criteria: Exactly one cyan circle
It sits roughly in the middle of the canvas

title: Two-ink overprint
prompt: Overlap a cyan circle and a magenta circle so that a blue-violet lens appears where they cross.
success_criteria: Two circles, one cyan and one magenta
A visible darker overlap region between them

title: Three-ink Venn
prompt: Make a three-circle Venn diagram in cyan, magenta and yellow so that green, red, blue and a dark center all appear.
success_criteria: Three circles, one per CMY ink
Pairwise overlaps show green, red and blue
A darker region where all three meet
Roughly triangular, balanced arrangement

title: Tonal ramp
prompt: Make a row of five equal squares that go from light grey to near-black, using only black at 50% opacity.
skills: building value by stacking identical marks
success_criteria: Five squares of equal size in a row
Each square is darker than the one before
Only black ink is used

title: Flower
prompt: Draw a single flower with eight petals, a dark center, a green stem and two leaves.
skills: mixing green from cyan and yellow
success_criteria: Eight evenly rotated petals
A distinct center
A stem below the bloom
Two leaves on the stem, reading as green

title: Sunny house
prompt: Draw a simple house on green grass under a sun: walls, pitched roof, a door, two windows, and a sun with rays.
skills: tiling large areas under the 96-unit span limit
success_criteria: Recognizable house with roof, door and two windows
Grass along the bottom
Sun with rays in the sky
Objects do not awkwardly overlap

title: Fruit tree
prompt: Draw a fruit tree: a trunk with branches, a full leafy canopy built from many small clusters, red fruit in the canopy and two fallen fruit on the ground.
skills: organic texture from many small marks
success_criteria: Trunk and visible branches
Canopy reads as a mass of leaves, not one blob
Shadowed side of the canopy is darker
Red fruit inside the canopy and on the ground

title: Twelve-fold mandala
prompt: Design a mandala with exact twelve-fold rotational symmetry: an inner ring, a ring of petals, a ring of spokes with ornaments, and a fine outer ring of ticks.
success_criteria: Twelve-fold symmetry holds for every ring
At least four distinct concentric rings
Centerd on the canvas
Uses all four inks deliberately

title: Mountain lake at dusk
prompt: Paint a mountain lake at dusk: a sky graded from blue at the top to warm at the horizon, a low sun, two mountain ranges for depth, a lake that reflects the sunset, and pine trees in the foreground.
success_criteria: Sky gradient from cool to warm without visible gaps
Far range lighter than near range
Lake reflects sunset colors
Foreground pines frame the scene
Clear horizon line

title: Harbor at sunset
prompt: Paint a harbor at sunset: warm sky, setting sun with a reflection on the water, a dark headland, three sailboats at different distances with wakes, a wooden pier with a lit lamp, and gulls overhead.
skills: budgeting marks across the whole image
success_criteria: Sun with a vertical reflection on the water
Three sailboats of different sizes suggesting depth
Each boat has hull, mast and sails
Pier with posts and a lit lamp
Gulls in the sky
Sea shows wave texture
Composition is balanced, not cluttered
